{{Quote|It's not the size of the Jedi or the amount of power running through her lightsaber, but the strength of her heart.|Barriss Offee|<ref name="AS" />}}
'''Barriss Offee''', a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], was a [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] who [[Jedi Trials/Legends|ascended]] to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knighthood]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] in [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]] to [[Parent/Legends|parents]] she would never again see, Offee was discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during [[Youngling/Legends|infancy]] and was brought to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When it came [[Time/Legends|time]] for her to start [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], she embarked under the tutelage of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], another Mirialan, who instructed her in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and also in the traditions of their shared heritage. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the escalating [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Offee joined Unduli in helping Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his Padawan, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|settle]] a border dispute on [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. Their efforts resulted in an accord between the [[Unity of Community]] and the native [[Alwari]] tribes, preventing the key backwater [[Planet/Legends|world]] from seceding from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Offee was thereafter part of the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi task force]] that went to rescue Kenobi, Skywalker, and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had sentenced them to [[Death/Legends|execution]]. The ensuing [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] sparked the Clone Wars, in which Offee became a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]], leading [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] alongside her Master. Besides [[Battle of Ilum|defending]] the Jedi Order's [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and employing her healing skills on [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]] and [[Null/Legends|Null]], Offee formed a friendship with fellow Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the Padawan of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]. That campaign saw Offee and Tano obliterate a major [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|battle droid foundry]] and they [[Skirmish aboard TB-73/Legends|quelled]] a following outbreak of mind-controlling Geonosian [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Offee was assigned to the crew of [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. Despite the growing temptation of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] Offee passed the trial and graduated to Jedi Knight.

Believing that the Jedi had fallen from the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] as a result of their heightened militancy in fighting the Clone Wars, she worked with activist [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] to orchestrate a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] of the Jedi Temple as a demonstration of her misgivings. Offee then framed her friend Tano for the bombing, as well as for her subsequent murder of Turmond. Although Offee posed as ex-Separatist [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to further manipulate Tano and ensure her friend's [[Capture of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|arrest]], Skywalker discovered the truth. After Skywalker [[Duel at the Jedi Temple/Legends|defeated]] her, Offee confessed to her crimes at Tano's [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|trial]] before being taken into Republic custody. At some point near the end of the war, Offee was released and took [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]] as her padawan. While on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], she was leading a squad until she was killed when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], marking her a victim of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|I was born on a liner in deep space. My parents' identities are unknown. I call no world save Coruscant my home.|Barriss Offee, to Zan Yant|<ref name="MBS" />}}
Born on a [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] in deep space,<ref name="MBS" /> Offee was brought to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], where she would spend her early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in study of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|barrissoffee|Offee, Barriss}}</ref> When she was three or four years old, Offee had been playing with a [[Color/Legends|blue]] ball in one of the Jedi Temple antechambers. When the ball rolled beyond her reach into one of the giant main chambers, Offee, instead of going after it, used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] the ball back to her for the first time. As she picked it up, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was standing behind her in the far entrance of the antechamber, impressed with what he had seen.<ref name="MBS" />

===Luminara Unduli's Padawan===
====Beginning the career====
{{Quote|How long have you been Master Luminara's Padawan?''"<br />"''Long enough to know that those who have their mouths open all the time generally have their ears shut.|Anakin Skywalker and Barriss Offee|<ref name="AS" />}}
[[File:Luminara_Unduli_Barriss_Offee_TCW.png|thumb|right|300px|Barriss Offee by her master's side]]
At some point, Offee became a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]. At the beginning of her training, she visited [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]],<ref name="PotJS">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of her [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TCSWE Mirialan">{{CSWECite|II|318|Mirialan}}</ref> When she reached sixteen years of age, she built her [[Barriss Offee's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="MJH">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref> During this [[Time/Legends|time]], Offee learned the correct [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Limb/Legends|hand]] grip from [[Tutso Mara/Legends|Tutso Mara]],<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> who further assisted her in honing her combat techniques as [[Time/Legends|time]] went on.<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> Furthermore, she occasionally trained with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], but they never spoke with each other.<ref name="FF 45">{{FactFile|45|OFF 1-2|Barriss Offee}}</ref>

====A levitation drill====
{{Quote|I could have simply stood up and looked over the wall. What was important was not how I got the information&mdash;only that I got it.|Barriss Offee|<ref name="MBS" />}}
At some point after a long hand-to-hand combat workout, Offee practiced with the lightsaber, which left her arms sore and burning. After the practice, Offee and her Master moved to a high-walled balcony, two hundred flights above the ground level. There, Unduli instructed Offee to do the [[Floating Meditation]], observe the small bakery across the way, and tell her how many pastries she sees in the window. As she tried to lift herself from the floor, Unduli reprimanded her that the Jedi do not limit themselves by "trying," to which Offee agreed. As she continued her practice, Offee had not been able to levitate, and her continued attempts made her rear and thighs numb from the cold [[Ferrocrete/Legends|ferrocrete]].<ref name="MBS" />

Hours later, Unduli returned to the balcony, and Offee felt she had failed the task, but her Master retorted that one could fail at the task but still learn the lesson. She recalled her time learning the Floating Meditation and told Barriss the story of the old man's river crossing, and asked if she understood it. Offee immediately felt incredibly stupid for not understanding the task, as she could have simply stood up and look over the wall to count the pastries.<ref name="MBS" />

====Dark side in the morning====
{{Quote|There may come a time when you experience this, Barriss. I hope not, but if ever it happens, you must recognize and resist it.''"<br />"''It will feel evil?''"<br />''"Oh, no. It will feel better than anything you have ever experienced, better than you would have thought anything could feel. It will feel empowering, fulfilling, satisfying. Worst of all, it will feel right. And therein lies the real danger.|Luminara Unduli and Barriss Offee|<ref name="MBS" />}}
One morning sometime after the levitation drill, Offee and her Master visited a four-hundred-year-old [[blackneedle tree]] at the [[Oa Park]] on Coruscant. In the middle of laughing people at the park, Offee thought for a moment that the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] was far away from her. But, as they stood in the tree's shade, Unduli warned her that it was always a threat. Even after hearing about it many times, Offee did not exactly understood what her Master meant, as they moved to the grassy spot in the park to practice a [[Salutation to the Force]]. Unduli explained to her that every action she made required choice.<ref name="MBS" />

As they practiced the [[Laser Pose]] and the [[Arch Pose]] of the Salutation, Unduli and Offee discussed her past training with the [[Marksman-H combat remote|training remotes]], and if she ever felt like destroying the remote instead of stopping the bolts. Unduli warned her Padawan that destroying the remote out of anger, pain, or fear meant reaching for the dark side, against which she should be vigilant. As she assumed the [[Rocker Pose]], Offee asked her Master if she ever felt the dark side. Unduli replied that in a moment of weakness and pain, she did, and it allowed her to survive, but that she would never do that again. She insisted to Offee that if it ever happened to her she must recognize and resist it, because it would feel empowering, fulfilling and satisfying.<ref name="MBS" />

===Mission to Ansion===
{{Main|Border dispute on Ansion/Legends}}
{{Quote|And that, my young Padawan, was a demonstration of what is known as dynamic diplomacy.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="AS" />}}
[[File:Barriss.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Offee's performance on Ansion]]
Shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Offee and Unduli&mdash;along with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;were sent to [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] to prevent the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from voting to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. However there were many beings set upon making sure the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] mission was a failure, one of them being the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin]] who had been hired by [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] to stop them.<ref name="AS" />

The Jedi were allowed to talk to the [[Unity of Community]]. Unduli made a deal to the Unity: The Jedi would put an end to a conflict between the 'city-folk' and the [[Alwari]] natives if Ansion agreed to stay within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and abide by their rules. The conflict was over land, so Unduli also said that they would get the Alwari to agree to share half or more of their land. The Unity agreed and the Jedi left.<ref name="AS" />

Before the Jedi could set off on their mission, two Alwari named [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]] were hired by Soergg to capture one of the Padawans. They [[Kidnapping of Barriss Offee|caught]] Offee and held her [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], however both the Alwari were mentally impaired and so Offee managed to gain their trust by healing them. After this Kyakhta and Bulgan agreed to act as guides for the Jedi, as to secure the treaty with the Alwari, they would first have to find them&mdash;specifically, the [[Borokii]] [[overclan]]. The Jedi left the [[City/Legends|city]] shortly after, riding [[suubatar]]. They shortly had more trouble with [[gairk]]s in a stream but overcame this as well.<ref name="AS" />

Eventually the Jedi managed to meet with the [[Yiwa]]&mdash;a lesser though not unimportant clan of the Alwari [[Qiemo Adrangar]] tribal faction. At first, the Yiwa were mistrustful of the Jedi, and the [[Highborn]] clan leader, [[Mazong]], requested that they each give a performance that would demonstrate that, beyond ability, they also possessed "''inner essence, unlike the representatives of the great but soulless Senate''", and that after this, the Yiwa would decide whether or not to tell the Jedi where the overclan was. Offee performed a [[compass dance]], an [[Acrobat/Legends|acrobatics]] display of movement and light (using her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]), which greatly impressed the Alwari, as well as Skywalker. After the other Jedi had given their presentationst, the Yiwa told them where the overclan could be found, and they set off again.<ref name="AS" />

Later, the Jedi came across a group of [[Gwurran]]. After humoring the pygmy-like creatures' intense curiosity concerning the strange "[[outlander]]s," the Jedi left, but [[Tooqui]]&mdash;a Gwurran&mdash;came with them. It was shortly after that the Jedi met with a non-traditional clan of traders called the [[Qulun]]. The Jedi and their Ansionian guides were offered food and accepted into their camp. The clan leader [[Baiuntu]], however, was working for Soergg, and managed to capture the Jedi. Luckily, Tooqui got away, and shortly after rescued the six of them.<ref name="AS" />

The Jedi soon came upon the [[Borokii]] overclan, to whom they gave their proposal. The Borokii agreed, but only on the grounds that the Jedi settle a conflict that existed between the Borokii and their longtime rival, the [[Januul]], another overclan. The Jedi agreed and ultimately managed to settle the conflict diplomatically. They then returned to the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]], [[Cuipernam]], where they were again delayed by Soergg, who had hired thugs to dispatch them. However the Jedi managed to make it to the gathering of the Unity, which was in the process of voting on the matter of secession. After witnessing Soergg kill [[Ogomoor]], his majordomo who knew about his crimes, Barriss Offee was enraged and realized that Soergg was behind her kidnapping and other attacks on the Jedi on Ansion.<ref name="AS" />

Due to the fact that the Jedi had settled the border dispute, the Unity voted to stay within the Republic. The Jedi's mission was a success.<ref name="AS" />

The mission to Ansion changed Barriss's attitude towards Anakin Skywalker for the better. After the mission, she told Anakin that she would be willing to be his interlocutor about the things that bothered Anakin.<ref name="AS" />

===Clone Wars===
====Battle of Geonosis====
When Offee and Unduli returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], they were dispatched by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] as part of the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] to rescue Kenobi, Skywalker and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Although Offee was not in the final circle that was picked up by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|gunships]], she did find a way out of the [[Petranaki arena]] along with several other Jedi, including [[Pablo-Jill/Legends|Pablo-Jill]], [[Roan Shryne]] and [[Bairdon Jace/Legends|Bairdon Jace]].

====Skirmish on Ilum====
{{Quote|Barriss Offee, your training is complete.|Luminara Unduli, to Barriss Offee|audio=BarrissOffeeTrainingComplete-CW14.flac|<ref name="CW14">{{CW|14}}</ref>}}
[[File:LuminaraBarriss_CW_ST.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Offee during the [[Ambush on Ilum]]]]
Later on during the Clone Wars, Offee and Unduli ventured to the ice-world [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. From this planet, the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] needed in the construction of a lightsaber could be found. In a secret [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Jedi temple]], Offee rebuilt her lightsaber.<ref name="CW14" />

As she constructed her lightsaber, the location of the temple was compromised. Separatist [[Chameleon droid/Legends|chameleon droids]] had infiltrated the mines and placed explosive charges in the tunnels. Offee and Unduli fought them off, but were trapped in the resulting cave-in using the Force to stop hold up the roof. This [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] reached Yoda and the diminutive Jedi Master rescued them.<ref name="CW16">{{CW|16}}</ref>

====Mission to Geonosis====
While her Master guarded [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] on the [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']], Offee oversaw a [[Mission to Geonosis (Barriss Offee)|mission]] to Geonosis.<ref name="CoD Decoded">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness|d=y}}</ref>

====Second Battle of Geonosis====
[[File:AhsokaBarriss-WF.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Offee and Tano at the time of the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]]]
Offee and her master were sent to the planet Geonosis to aid Jedi General Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], in helping destroy the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|weapons factory]], headed by [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]]. Tano and Offee were sent under to the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]], while Skywalker and Unduli acted as decoys. The Padawans made it to their destination, however they had been spotted and were attacked by the new Confederate [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]], as well as [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], and the bombs they had planted were removed while the two were distracted.<ref name="TCWWF">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>

While Tano was stunned, Offee cut a hole through the top of the tank with her lightsaber and entered as the pilots fled. Opening the hatch, she invited the now-conscious Ahsoka into the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]. Ahsoka came to the conclusion that the only way to destroy the factory would be to use the tank's weapons to fire upon the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]], even though they believed it likely they would not survive the explosion.<ref name="TCWWF" />

Neither knew just how good the shielding on the tank was, though, which protected the two Padawans from the explosion. Afterward they were buried under a large amount of debris. Worried they would [[Death/Legends|die]] from lack of air, Tano pulled a power cell apart, activating her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] so their masters could find them. Skywalker picked up the signal, and he and Luminara tracked it to their location and used their Force [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to remove the debris and free their Padawans.<ref name="TCWWF" />

====Skirmish aboard TB-73====
Offee and Tano were transporting a [[TB-73/Legends|supply ship]] to the [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|Ord Cestus medical station]]. The Padawans decided to get some [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]] but none would come to Tano, so the two decided to go get something to eat. Unknown to them, a [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|clone trooper]] was leaving the [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] to spread across the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. While Tano and Offee were eating, two clones tried to kill them, which they incapacitated. Later in the ship, [[Trap/Legends|Trap]] tried to infect them with the worms; Offee was forced to kill him.<ref name="TCWBI">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>

[[File:BarrissInfected-BrainInvaders.jpg|thumb|right|220px|An infected Offee attacks Tano.]]
After discovering the clones upon their ship were being controlled by brain worms, Offee and Tano separated. Offee was heading to the engineering section to disable the ship's [[Engine/Legends|engines]] when she walked into a trap set by the clones. She was unable to resist as the clones exposed her to a brain worm, and then succumbed to the worm's influence. When she found Tano, the two began a duel. Tano tried to convince Offee to resist being controlled, and was ignored as Offee continued the attack. Later on, after Tano released [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] that affected the brain worms' control, Offee confronted her in the cockpit. After having super-cooled air blown onto her face, she was able to regain enough control to beg Tano to kill her, ensuring the worm's death. Tano refused. When the worm tried to flee Offee's body and enter Tano's directly, Tano sliced the worm in half, releasing Offee from its mind control.<ref name="TCWBI" />

====Capture of Eeth Koth====
Offee was present in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] sent a message to the Jedi, informing of his [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|capture of Eeth Koth]]. Offee witnessed the brutal [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] of the captured Koth. When Master Yoda ordered the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] taken out of the room, Offee accompanied them and some other Jedi.<ref name="TCWGI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>

====Battle of Umbara====
[[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] Offee, with the assistance of Commander Tano, managed to blast through the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] over the shadow planet of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] allowing clone and Jedi forces onto the planet in an effort to [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|capture it]]. Offee piloted a [[Barriss Offee's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B light interceptor]] to complete this task.<ref name="TCWDoU">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref>

====Coruscant Insurrection====
During the [[Coruscant Insurrection|Invasion of Coruscant]], Offee commanded a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of clone troopers in the fight against Separatist droid forces. In the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels of the city]], her squad was overrun by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], including the new [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droids]] that were resistant to her lightsaber. Just in time, young Anakin Skywalker arrived at the scene and managed to push back the droid forces.<ref name="Star Wars: The New Droid Army">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref>

====Mission to Drongar====
{{Quote|During her tour of duty as a healer, Jedi Barriss Offee accidentally discovered that a dose of the distillate greatly enhanced her connection to the Force. She described it as being linked to all beings, all places, throughout all times. Jedi Offee wasn't one to overly indulge in hyperbole, so I assume that her assessment was a straightforward one, metaphysical as it may sound.|I-5YQ|<ref name="Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>}}
[[File:BarrissSBD.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Offee destroys a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] on Drongar.]]
Afterward, Offee was sent to the planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]; her first mission without her master. Drongar was the home to a valuable [[Plant/Legends|plant]], [[Bota/Legends|bota]], which was a miracle cure for almost anything and for any race, prized by both the Galactic Republic and the Separatists. Offee, a gifted healer, assisted one of the medical units on the planet. Unknown to her, a [[Klo Merit|spy]] was sneaking around the camp and several corrupt Republic representatives were shipping off bota illegally for their own profit. Offee also met the deadly [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] instructor, [[Phow Ji]], who despised the Jedi. Ji tested Offee to her limit, but she did not give in to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. He was eventually killed in a suicidal attack. Offee also suffered the loss of [[Zan Yant]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] surgeon who had been a friend of hers.<ref name="MBS" />

In a turn of events, she accidentally injected herself with bota, and the natural drug opened up the Force in new and powerful ways. Offee found this quick way to power to be too addictive and knew that it would lead her towards the dark side of the Force, but she resisted its luring pull. Once she had overcome the inner battle of resisting the dark side, she felt that she had earned the rank of Jedi Knight and General.<ref name="MJH" />

==== Battle on Phorose ====
{{Quote|Anger, fear, hatred... These are the emotions of which a Jedi must be wary. But what about our ''guilt''?|Barriss Offee, questioning the ideals of the Jedi|<ref name="Paradise Lost" />}}Barriss Offee took part in the [[Battle of Phorose|battle]] of [[Phorose]] alongside Ahsoka Tano. During the battle, both Padawans were ambushed by [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] and fell in an underground temple, leading to the accidental discovery of a community of [[Ru]]. However, a group of battle droids ambushed the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and destroyed the Ru temple. After the temple's destruction, Tano and Offee decided to evacuate the remaining Ru to a safe location, far from the battle. Unfortunately, the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] carrying the two Padawans and the Ru was ambushed by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], leading to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Ru, with only two Ru and the two Jedi surviving. Despite Tano apologized to her for initiating the idea of ​​this evacuation, but Offee said that all Jedi were to blame for this. Tano tried to console her but no avail.<ref name="Paradise Lost">{{TCWComicCite|6.52|Paradise Lost}}</ref>

====Temple bombing====
{{Quote|I did it. Because I've come to realize what many people in the Republic have come to realize, that the Jedi are the ones responsible for this War. That we've so lost our way that we have become villains in this conflict, that we are the ones that should be put on trial, all of us! And my attack on the Temple was an attack on what the Jedi have become: an army fighting for the dark side, fallen from the Light that we once held so dear. This Republic is failing! It's only a matter of time.|Barriss Offee admitting to, and explaining, her actions to the court|<ref name="TCWTWJ">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>}}
[[File:BarrissOffeeQuarters-TCAJ.png|thumb|right|250px|Offee secretly talking to Tano via comlink in her [[Barriss Offee's quarters/Legends|quarters]]]]
Offee's view space on the Jedi Order had changed towards the end of the war. She arranged the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]], and Ahsoka Tano became the one blamed.<ref name="TCWTWJ" /> Whilst many thought Tano was guilty of murdering [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]], a woman suspected of bombing the Jedi Temple, there were others who believed Tano to have been set up, such as Offee. Offee 'helped' Tano in hiding and was secretly involved with giving her instructions. Tano contacted Offee through a public comlink so that the clones could not track her or Offee. Offee led Tano to a [[Abandoned munitions warehouse/Legends|warehouse]] so that Tano would be able to find out who set her up, when someone with Ventress's [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|lightsabers]] and mask engaged Tano in a duel, which ended when Tano fell off a balcony and landed near crates of [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]]&mdash;similar to those used in the bombing&mdash;and was found by the clones.<ref name="TCWTCaJ" />

While Tano's [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|trial]] was taking place, Skywalker found [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Ventress]], who told him that someone other than herself was behind it, someone who took her weapons and mask. She also told him that Tano had been in contact with Offee. Skywalker decided to question Offee, who revealed ultimately that the bombing was her work. She engaged Skywalker in a heated duel which ended when Skywalker wounded her and used the Force to capture her.<ref name="TCWTWJ" />

As Tano was about to be pronounced guilty, Skywalker burst in with Offee, who told the truth to the court, stating that she felt that the Jedi were corrupt, and that they should be the ones on trial. Ahsoka was given an apology and an offer to come back into the Jedi Order. Feeling betrayed because they had not believed her before, she refused.<ref name="TCWTWJ" />

===Order 66===
[[File:BarrissOffeeDeath-ROTS03.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The death of Barriss Offee]]
Offee remained in the Jedi Order and in partnership with her former Master until the end of the Clone Wars. Despite her attack upon the Temple, she found redemption and took [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]] as her padawan. Dispatched to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] to serve as a healer with her new apprentice, they were captured by [[Gossam Commandos/Legends|Gossam Commandos]] working for the Confederacy of Independent Systems and thrown in prison. They were later rescued by the Jedi [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]], as well as the [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]] [[Galle/Legends|Galle]]. It was later revealed that Presidente [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] had arranged to poison Felucia's water supply, and so Offee and Secura sought to save the planet.

Following Lieutenant Galle, Offee took a squad to [[Har Gau/Legends|Har Gau]] while Secura and Commander [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] went to [[Niango/Legends|Niango]].<ref name="ROF">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref> When Offee's group arrived at their site, they saw that the defenders consisted mostly of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], rather than [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and realized they could not simply blast their way into the center. Padawan [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]], who had accompanied Secura to the planet, enlisted Galle's help for his plan. In order for the Padawans to infiltrate the water plant, Zonder drew the attention of the Gossam Commandos, while Galle and the Padawans attacked, striking down the droids. The Padawans then detached from Galle's squad, moving into position near the center. Lo'gaan commed Galle, ordering him to activate the next phase of the plan, and Galle called for a retreat. The defenders pursued, leaving the way wide open for the Padawans to infiltrate the plant and stop the toxins.<ref name="ROF" />

As Galle fell back, Bly received an encrypted message from Coruscant, ordering him to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a contingency order that demanded the deaths of all Jedi. Galle and his squad rendezvoused with Offee, who was fighting off a number of battle droids. Galle came to a halt, and Offee ordered him to fire. The lieutenant complied;<ref name="ROF" /> he ordered an AT-TE to open fire on Offee, blowing her remains to ashes.<ref name="ROF" /><ref name="Felucia">{{DB|location|felucia|Felucia}}</ref> As Offee died, lightyears away, her former master perished also.<ref name="Hidden Enemy 2">[[Republic 82|''Republic'' 82]]</ref> Galle filed the details of Offee's death in an incident report #890-F, that would later be included in an Order 66 [[Casualty Report: Order 66|report]] compiled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Marcellin Wessel]] and presented to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Order 66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|You knew Barriss?''"<br />"''Both of us did. Now, she's what I call a Jedi. She's compassionate, kind, and tolerant of—''"<br />"''She's dead.''"<br />"''How?''"<br />"''I don't know for certain. But I know she's dead. The Force doesn't lie.''"<br />"''I thought something like that had happened. I didn't want to believe it. She was one in a trillion.|Jax Pavan and Den Dhur|<ref name="Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>}}
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] emerged, the official records, which were modified by [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] from the casualty report of Order 66, stated that Offee and Secura were both executed because they were plotting to poison Felucia's water supply.<ref name="Order 66" /> [[19 BBY/Legends|Three months]] after Offee's death, she was remembered by her friends from Drongar, [[Den Dhur]] and [[I-5YQ]]. In a conversation with the Jedi Knight [[Jax Pavan]], who had sensed her die through the Force, Den Dhur had come to terms with her death. Furthermore, I-Five realized that he was self-aware thanks to the help of his friends, including Offee.<ref name="Jedi Twilight" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] remembered Barriss Offee alongside [[Ali-Alann]] as he exiled himself to watch over young [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="The Desperate Mission">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've learned that 'trust' is overrated. The only thing the Jedi Council believes in is ''violence''!|Barriss Offee, expressing her [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|views]]|<ref name="TCWTWJ" />}}
[[File:BarrissDisguised-TCWs5BR2.png|thumb|right|Offee disguised as Asajj Ventress]]
Barriss Offee was a thoughtful and observant person. She was generally reserved by nature but couldn't be intimidated easily. As a Padawan, she had a slightly impulsive streak which was frowned upon by some elder Jedi. She had also mentioned once that she would prefer negotiations with a lightsaber over diplomacy to settle differences as she felt it was much more straightforward.<ref name="AS" />

Padawan Offee also demonstrated, however, in her growing gift as a healer, a very compassionate side&mdash;especially towards the galaxy's disenfranchized, such as the clanless [[Ansionian|Ansonians]] [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]], both of whom she healed from mental infirmities, and the derrided [[Gwurran]] [[Tooqui]], whom she befriended.<ref name="AS" />

Offee was also selfless and was willing to sacrifice her own life to save other lives. This was proven when she and Ahsoka Tano blew up a droid factory from the inside in the Second Battle of Geonosis, even with the full knowledge that they would probably be destroyed along with it.<ref name="tcwce">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Fortunately, they both survived because they were inside a heavily armored tank. Offee became friends with Tano during the mission. Shortly after this incident, while escorting a medical frigate, Offee was infected by one of the Geonosian brain worms which had taken over the ship. While dueling Tano, she managed to resist the worm's influence for a moment&mdash;only to plead with Tano to kill her as she believed that was the only way to stop the parasites. This showed that she had a strong will.

Offee was originally loyal to her master Luminara Unduli and was almost always by Unduli's side while apprenticed to her. After being made a Jedi Knight, Offee was still uncertain if she deserved to be granted this rank, but after resisting the lure of the dark side during a mission on Drongar, she became more confident about her promotion. Offee was known to have a somewhat unorthodox view of the Force as she believed that the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] and the dark side were only words and the Force was neither good nor evil, whereas most Jedi believed the light side was good and the dark side was evil.<ref name="MJH" />

However, she began to doubt the Jedi Order's role as peacekeepers. Events such as the [[Battle of Phorose]] influenced her, as she came to believe that the Jedi and the Republic were responsible for the deaths of innocents, and eventually came to the conclusion that the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] only believed in violence. Offee decided that the Council were nothing more than arrogant, violent tyrants, and was determined to bring down the Order since she became convinced that it had become corrupt. However, Offee's change of heart shaped her into a zealot who was prepared to allow her friend Ahsoka Tano to almost be executed, and to kill innocents such as Letta Turmond as well as many clone troopers.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref><ref name="TCWTWJ" /><ref>[[Paradise Lost|''Paradise Lost'']]</ref>

Offee also manipulated and lied to the Order, allowing Tano to be blamed for the bombing. Nevertheless, when Anakin Skywalker took her in custody, Offee did confess. When placed on trial, Offee stated defiantly that the Jedi Order were pawns of the dark side. However, the aggression she displayed in her duels with Tano and Skywalker proved that Barriss had ultimately become the very thing she intended to destroy, in attempting to fight against the corruption of the Jedi, she herself had become corrupted.<ref name="TCWTWJ" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|It's an honor to face you. I hope to learn much from our combat.|Barriss Offee, to a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Barriss_medstar2.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Barriss [[Jedi healer/Legends|healing]] a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]]]
Barriss Offee had the ability to use [[Floating Meditation]] and was a skilled Jedi Healer which came in handy during the Clone Wars. On Ilum, she displayed the ability to use telekinesis to a high degree and along with her master she was able to hold up the roof of the cave they were trapped in until Yoda arrived to rescue them. She also used this ability to transfer explosive charges onto the chameleon droid intruders and crush a few more by bringing the roof down on them.

After turning against the Jedi Order, Offee became considerably more powerful, being able to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|Force Choke]] Letta Turmond to death without being in the same room, or even needing a live feed to focus. She also showed an impressive talent for [[Force stealth|stealth]] being able to evade the [[Force sense/Legends|Force senses]] of both Ahsoka Tano and Asajj Ventress, both of whom had considerable Force senses. Offee was able to stun Ventress, a well known Jedi killer who had previously slain even Jedi Masters, effortlessly by ambushing her and telekinetically hurling debris at her before slamming her over the head with a pipe.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /><ref name="TCWTCaJ" />

[[File:BarrissOffee-FFp61.png|thumb|right|250px|Barriss Offee was a Soresu practitioner.]]
Like her Master, Offee practiced the [[Form III/Legends|Soresu]] fighting style and her ability with her lightsaber was great enough for her to survive the ferocious battle of Geonosis, even though she wasn't on the gunships that rescued the Jedi. She was skilled in tandem fighting where her movements would be in sync with her partners in battle. This could be seen clearly when fighting alongside her Master&mdash;together she and Unduli were a formidable team in combat.<ref name="MJH" />

After turning to the dark side, Offee's fighting style grew more ferocious and she seemed to mirror Asajj Ventress' aggressive technique as noted by Ahsoka Tano who thought she was dueling Ventress when Offee attacked her, although this was more because of the fact that Offee was using Ventress' lightsabers rather than her fighting style. However, having dueled Ventress several times, Tano would probably have noticed if Offee was using a different style, so it is heavily implied that Offee was trained in the use of [[Form II/Legends|Makashi]] as well as Soresu. Offee showed skill in [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]], being able to overwhelm Tano and even hold her own against Anakin Skywalker (though he eventually captured her by placing her in a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Grip|Force grip]]), despite the fact that she was wielding unfamiliar lightsabers.<ref name="TCWTCaJ" /><ref name="TCWTWJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Portrayal===
[[File:BarrissOffee-TCWForceWarriors.png|thumb|left|300px|Barriss Offee, as portrayed in ''The Clone Wars'']]
Offee was portrayed in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] by [[Nalini Krishan]]. She was voiced by [[Tatyana Yassukovich]] in the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' cartoon and [[Meredith Salenger]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|2008 ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' TV series]].<ref name="SWArchive-In the Hands of The Padawans&hellip;">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news11102009/index.html|text=In the Hands of The Padawans&hellip;}}</ref> Offee was introduced in the novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', which was written by [[Alan Dean Foster]]. It was a tie-in to ''Attack of the Clones'' released several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later. The Ansion dispute from the novel was mentioned in ''Attack of the Clones'', in which Offee also had a cameo in Chancellor Palpatine's [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]] and at the Battle of Geonosis.

While a great deal of [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] material holds Offee to be around her twenties during the Clone Wars,<ref name="Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi" /> her depiction in ''The Clone Wars'' series was intended to age down the character, with Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]] intending for her to only be "a little bit older" than Ahsoka Tano.<ref name="Complete Season Two">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]], "Return to Geonosis" DVD Featurette</ref> "[[Weapons Factory]]" director [[Giancarlo Volpe]], in his own words, "secretly" pushed for Tano and Offee to enter a romantic relationship.<ref name="Ahsoka/Barriss">{{Tumblr|subdomain=giancarlovolpe|url=post/94796479979/gizzlescribbles-hmmm-whatever-its-late|name=Giancarlo Volpe|text=Barriss Ahsoka|date=2014-08-14|quote=I can't believe someone ships Barrissokka. You have no idea how hard I secretly pushed this agenda in <s>"Droid Factory"</s> "Weapons Factory" (thank you for pointing out my mistake - I have worked on a lot of shows, I some times get the titles confused.)"}}</ref>

===Continuity===
====Early contradictions====
''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' as well as ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' identify Offee as [[Human/Legends|Human]]. However, Mirialans are [[Near-Human]] and thus not part of the Human species.

In the [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary|''Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary'']], it is stated that Barriss Offee's tattoos are [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactan]] in nature. In the [[MedStar Duology]], however, this fact has been corrected. Officially, Offee's tattoos are traditionally Mirialan.

====Fate====
Offee was originally supposed to be in the Order 66 sequence but was cut along with the deaths of Luminara Unduli and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. Unused footage from ''Attack of the Clones'' was going to be used for this appearance.<ref name="C.C. Banana">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ccbanana.com/main/interviews/starwars1.htm|text=C.C. Banana Interviews the Stars of ''STAR WARS''!|work=[[Wikipedia:C.C. Banana|C.C. Banana]]|archivedate=20070512233219|nolive=1}}</ref>

Because of Offee's actions in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season 5]] finale "[[The Wrong Jedi]]," her fate later into the Clone Wars, specifically her being a victim to Order 66 as well as her involvement in the ''MedStar'' books, has been left ambiguous. [[Leland Chee]] hasn't commented much on resolving the issue, although he has stated that it wasn't necessarily stated that she was still a Padawan in the episode regarding the stance on ''MedStar'', thus leaving it open to interpretation.

====Age====
As noted, when Offee was introduced into ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'', Offee was intended to be, in the words of Dave Filoni, only "a little bit older than" Ahsoka Tano,<ref name="Complete Season Two" /> who begins the series as a fourteen year old.<ref name="TCWn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> This also allowed episode director Giancarlo Volpe to "secretly" push for a Tano-Offee romance.<ref name="Ahsoka/Barriss" /> Other Legends material, however, suggests Offee to be closer to Anakin Skywalker's age.<ref name="Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi" /><ref name="AS" />
